title: The etale local ring at a geometric point as a colimit over etale algebras with a point
statement:
Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $ ar x:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega	o Y$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point] lying over $y\in Y$, and let $\kappa( ar x)\subset\Omega$ be the separable algebraic closure [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure] of the residue field $\kappa(y)$ [def-weil-residue-field] in $\Omega$ (with $\kappa(y)	o\Omega$ given by $ ar x$). Let $U=\operatorname{Spec}A\subset Y$ be an affine open containing $y$ and $\mathfrak p\subset A$ the prime ideal of $y$, so that $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=\kappa(y)$. Let $\mathcal N$ be the category of affine pointed etale neighbourhoods $(V=\operatorname{Spec}A_V, ar v)$ of $ ar x$ [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods] (a morphism $(V', ar v')	o(V, ar v)$ is a $Y$-morphism $V'	o V$ carrying $ ar v'$ to $ ar v$), and let $\mathcal T$ be the category of triples $(B,\mathfrak q,\phi)$ where $A	o B$ is a ring map with $\operatorname{Spec}B	o\operatorname{Spec}A$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], $\mathfrak q\subset B$ is a prime lying over $\mathfrak p$, and $\phi:\kappa(\mathfrak q)	o\kappa( ar x)$ is a homomorphism of $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$-algebras; a morphism $(B,\mathfrak q,\phi)	o(B',\mathfrak q',\phi')$ is an $A$-algebra map $ eta:B	o B'$ with $ eta^{-1}(\mathfrak q')=\mathfrak q$ and $\phi'\circ\kappa( eta)=\phi$. Then:

1. $\mathcal N$ is cofiltered: it is nonempty, any two objects receive morphisms from a common object, and any two parallel morphisms $V'ightrightarrows V$ are equalized by a morphism $V''	o V'$.
2. The full subcategory $\mathcal N_U\subset\mathcal N$ of those $(V, ar v)$ for which $V	o Y$ factors through $U$ is initial: every object of $\mathcal N$ receives a morphism from an object of $\mathcal N_U$. Hence the colimit $\varinjlim_{(V, ar v)\in\mathcal N}A_V$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] is canonically the colimit over $\mathcal N_U$.
3. For $(V=\operatorname{Spec}B, ar v)$ in $\mathcal N_U$ let $v\in V$ be the image of $ ar v$, $\mathfrak q_v\subset B$ its prime, and $\phi_v:\kappa(\mathfrak q_v)	o\Omega$ the field homomorphism corresponding to $ ar v$ [def-weil-geometric-point]. Then $\phi_v$ is a $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$-algebra map with image in $\kappa( ar x)$, and $(V, ar v)\mapsto(B,\mathfrak q_v,\phi_v)$ is an equivalence of $\mathcal N_U$ with the opposite of $\mathcal T$. Consequently $\varinjlim_{\mathcal N}A_V=\varinjlim_{(B,\mathfrak q,\phi)\in\mathcal T}B$ canonically, compatibly with the maps from each $A_V$, $(V, ar v)\in\mathcal N_U$.
